notes:
Full-depth wave: one scene per inventoried record, whole-first opening references the wave-1 S3 whole without duplicating it. Scene texts quote the bound record's committed title and first prose line; nothing is invented. 3 of the family's records moved on origin/main since the census freeze; each is flagged in records_bound. Presented under the family-factory tint pair per s-products-corpus-base.

Moves: the product root opens on the intent — 'I carry an intention into work that can be trusted' — staged as emergence (the Factory's why before its how) with the member's automation LFO breathing there; the source definition and capability matrix hold (definition and evidence addresses); native attempt operations gather (attempts, owner delivery, Return intake); CI coverage holds (the required factory-rust check on every PR); placement gathers (room placement for attempts — provenance seam); the documentation map walks; native Run thought consumption turns (the run consumes thought); the SSSF fidelity records hold; the implementation README gathers; provenance and third-party notices settle (attribution at rest).

3D: the whole scene carries the member's depth — z is the Factory's own transformation depth: intention and commission nearest, the re-formed result deepest (laminated; depthPerspective on). Pointers follow the arc's meaning (guard=canon holds its edges, gather=material intake, vortex=the run turns, rupture=gate refusal/cutover, settle=acceptance quiet). Automation: a dispersion LFO on one scene per member — the run breathes. Durations/transitions step 10–16s / 1.2–2.2 with the arc.

Sequences are the Factory's native grammar: the title formation walks its own heading segments and re-forms at its address stamp.
